subject.title: feat: add disposable Vercel and Convex PR previews

question: Should this PR merge after operator confirmation of Vercel Preview secret scoping and production API/feed smoke, or pause until the remaining Preview-targeted shared environment records are cleaned up?
rationale: The code path is reviewable, but the key security boundary depends on live Vercel and Convex environment targeting that the repository diff and CI cannot fully prove.

options.title: Confirm Env Then Merge
options.body: Require a maintainer/operator to confirm Preview-only deploy key scoping, no production secrets in previews, and production API/feed smoke on the final head before landing.

options.title: Accept Operator Follow-Up
options.body: Merge with the current proof while explicitly owning the remaining Vercel environment cleanup as tracked release/operator work.

options.title: Pause For Env Cleanup
options.body: Hold the branch until Preview-targeted shared environment records are removed and proof is refreshed against the final configuration.

recommendation.title: Confirm Env Then Merge
recommendation.body: Require a maintainer/operator to confirm Preview-only deploy key scoping, no production secrets in previews, and production API/feed smoke on the final head before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the clearest current-main and PR history on the deployment, runtime env, and seed surfaces being changed.
